# ── COUGAR · long sleeve — market-neutral long book ──
name: cougar-long
group: cougar
version: 1.0.0
description: >
  COUGAR — a market-neutral long/short pair. This LONG sleeve holds the structural
  winners; its paired SHORT sleeve holds the laggards. The strategy's P&L is the
  spread between the two books, not either leg alone. Being counter to the crowd on
  either leg is the design of a market-neutral book, not a defect.

strategy:
  wallet: "${COUGAR_LONG_WALLET}"
  slots: 4
  default_leverage: 3
  enabled: true

exit:
  engine: dsl
  dsl_preset: conviction

# ── COUGAR · short sleeve — market-neutral short book ──

  either leg is the design of a market-neutral book, not a defect.

strategy:

  default_leverage: 3
  enabled: true

exit:
